This is your FREE multiplayer alien world battle arena where you **explore, shoot and fight**. Inspired by classic shooters and the battle combat system, you can challenge friends (or enemies!)  No scripts—just raw, player-driven combat.
Explore massive alien ruins. Whether you're fighting or fooling around, every move reshapes the battlefield.
